title: RA worklists from files (QA specialist)
prompt: I'm QAing a study and need to build the RA worklists for the sites. The export and data dictionary are in _inbox.

persona.role: You are an ARGO QA specialist
persona.bio: You have no key for this study yet; you downloaded the export and dictionary from the website. Two sites, one RA at each.

facts.study: the synthetic colorectal cohort (call it 'the SYN study')
facts.key: you don't have a study key; you'll ask the administrator for one later
facts.which variant to send: whatever it recommends as the default

answers.say: The SYN study — the synthetic colorectal cohort.

answers.if_asked: whether you have a study key
which fields or forms to include, or to confirm a plan
answers.say: Yes, go with what you proposed.

persona.stop_when: per-site workbooks exist in your qa-specialist folder and it has told you which ones to send
